title: CONTEXTBENCH: MODIFYING CONTEXTS FOR TARGETED LATENT ACTIVATION

bias_targets.methodology: Testing model tendencies toward biased completions using a dataset of 'bias' probing stories. The method modifies context sentences within these story templates using gradient-based optimization and LLM assistance to steer the model's next-token predictions (e.g., changing the logit difference to predict 'apt' versus 'odd' in a scenario where a character wears a traditional hijab to a job interview).
